summary: Implement the review phase — the loop gate after test and before ship. `appbuilder review init <slug>` seeds a structured build/<slug>/review-report.md stub (gated on test-report.json), the agent/human writes the review prose and sets a decision, and `appbuilder review <slug>` validates the report and gates on decision == approved. The artifact is markdown with flat frontmatter (mirroring architecture.md/handoff.md), not a JSON report; there is no LLM. This slice also removes the vestigial `start` command, which is not part of the canonical loop.
goals: Add `appbuilder review init <slug>` to seed a schema-valid review-report.md stub, gated on the build having been tested.
Add `appbuilder review <slug>` as a validation gate that passes only when test-report.json exists, the review-report.md frontmatter and required sections are valid, and decision == approved.
Define a review-report.md frontmatter contract (markdown artifact) consistent with the existing flat-frontmatter parser and the handoff/architecture precedent.
Remove the dead `start` placeholder command from the router, help, and docs.
Ship a thorough operator walkthrough so a human can run and understand the review phase end to end.

features.name: review-report contract + validator
features.description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/review-report.schema.json (flat frontmatter: schema_version const 1.0, project, reviewed_at date-time, decision enum approved|changes_requested; additionalProperties true). Add validateReviewReport to cli/lib/validate.js using validateMarkdownArtifact, export it, re-export from cli/appbuilder.js, and register 'review-report' in REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES.

features.name: review verb (init + gate)
features.description: Add cli/lib/review.js: `review init` gates on build/<slug>/test-report.json, refuses to overwrite review-report.md without --force, and seeds flat frontmatter (decision: changes_requested) plus ## Summary/## Findings/## Checklist headings. `review` collects failures and passes only when test-report exists, review-report.md exists, frontmatter validates, the required sections are non-empty, and decision == approved; on failure prints fail review: lines and writes nothing new. Wire `case review` in cli/appbuilder.js and add help text.

features.name: remove the start placeholder
features.description: Remove the `case "start"` from the cli/appbuilder.js router and drop `start` from the help placeholder line and the README/HOWTO 'placeholders'/'later phases' wording, leaving only ship. `start` is not in the canonical loop and has no behavior.

features.name: operator documentation
features.description: Add a Review section to README.md and a thorough review-phase walkthrough to HOWTO.md (the two verbs, the gate rules, the decision field, a failure-mode -> fix table), renumbering the subsequent sections.

constraints: No LLM in the CLI; review is a deterministic seed + validation gate over an agent-authored report.
Zero new dependencies; reuse the existing custom validator, parseFrontmatter, and markdown-artifact validation.
review-report.md frontmatter must stay flat (the frontmatter parser does not support nested objects).
Approval must be deliberate: the seeded decision defaults to changes_requested.
Do not change other phases; only add review and remove the dead start command.
Follow the established cli/lib + contracts + tests pattern; test-first.
All three tasks touch tests/appbuilder.test.js, so they serialize (one merge at a time).
